title: OmniX: A first jet and event model
abstract: arXiv:2611.31403v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Foundation models are a new approach to building machine learning algorithms for particle physics. Their central idea is that a single model can be adapted to a variety of downstream tasks, amortizing training costs. So far, most foundation model prototypes have operated on the constituents of a single jet. This limits their usefulness for physics problems at the scale of full events, such as distinguishing different processes, and restricts their performance, as global correla- tions are invisible to the model. Here, we introduce OmniX, an architecture that operates on both single jets and whole events within a single model. Using the jet-level JetClass and Top-tagging datasets and the event-level Collide-2V dataset, we demonstrate that OmniX trained jointly on single jets and full events matches or exceeds otherwise equivalent jet-only and event-only models in generation and classification.

translated_title: OmniX：首个喷注与事件统一模型
translated_abstract: 基础模型是构建粒子物理机器学习算法的一种新方法，其核心思想是单个模型可以适应多种下游任务，从而摊薄训练成本。迄今为止，大多数基础模型原型仅在单个喷注的组成部分上运行，这限制了它们在全事件尺度物理问题（如区分不同物理过程）中的实用性，同时也限制了其性能，因为模型无法捕捉全局关联。本文提出OmniX，这是一种能够在单个模型中同时处理单个喷注和完整事件的架构。利用喷注级的JetClass和Top-tagging数据集以及事件级的Collide-2V数据集，我们证明了在单个喷注和完整事件上联合训练的OmniX，在生成和分类任务中能够达到甚至超过同等的仅喷注模型和仅事件模型的性能。
tldr: 本文提出OmniX，首个能在单一模型中同时处理喷注级和事件级数据的基础模型架构，其通过联合训练在生成和分类任务上达到甚至超越了专用的仅喷注或仅事件模型。
en_tdlr: OmniX is the first foundation model architecture that operates on both single jets and full events within a single model, matching or exceeding equivalent jet-only and event-only models in generation and classification tasks.
